verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page claims 2,000+ page support, which covers thousand-page documents. Every processing endpoint has an asynchronous mode, with polling helpers and webhooks for production workloads, which addresses long-running jobs and timeouts. Missing for 10: documented file-size limits or multi-gigabyte file handling, explicit guarantees or detection against silent truncation, in-depth docs on large-document behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of reliability at scale.

support.subject: As a data engineer, thousand-page documents and multi-gigabyte files process reliably without timeouts or silent truncation

citations.quote: Every processing endpoint in Extend (extract, classify, split, parse, and edit) supports both a synchronous and asynchronous mode.
how to use SDK polling helpers and webhooks for production workloads.
